name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
What's new since v3.45.0

📈 Cross-role forecast and epic groups (3.48.0) — “Forecast dates” in the “All roles” Gantt mode schedules every sprint role at once in dependency order (links and the task chain, one queue per person and role); issues left without dates are marked “waiting for … · role” / “over capacity” and listed in a “No dates after forecast” block, a link cycle raises a warning. Subtasks are grouped under their parent epic inside a role track (the parent bar spans the subtasks, the group collapses). No schema change.

📊 Cross-role Gantt (3.47.0) — an “All roles” switch on the Gantt chart shows the whole sprint at once: one track per role, the task chain between roles by work phases, schedule conflicts (“starts before the predecessor ends”, “outside the role’s phase”) with outlined bars and a counter, phase bands on the timeline. Dates and assignees of any role are edited right on the chart; the mode and zoom are remembered, and a shared link opens the same mode. No schema change.

🚫 Excluded issues with a reason (3.46.0) — switching an issue to “Excluded from sprint” now asks why (required, up to 500 characters); with cross-role exclusion on, the same reason and the same who/when stamp go to every role at once. Excluded issues leave the role table for an “Excluded from sprint (N)” block below it — the reason, who excluded and when, “Return” and “Edit reason” buttons, the full text as a tooltip. The reason shows as a tooltip on the status in sprint history and as an “Exclusion reason” column in the Excel export. The “Hide tasks excluded from sprint” switch is gone. Schema 3.45.0 → 3.46.0, rollback floor 3.46.0.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Planner settings for the project: functional roles and issue fields, permission groups (validation / editing / assignee assignment / history clearing), planning modes. Sprint planning itself lives in the main-menu item «Smart Sprint Planner».

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint planning from YouTrack's main menu: pick an accessible project where the planner is set up, plan sprint composition by role, allocate tasks, review history. Permissions and settings are checked against the selected project. Includes a «Backlog» module for triaging and laying pool tasks into roles/sprint.
